_comment: Real, currently-in-progress production batches -- distinct from docs/whistlebird-production-sheet-source.json, which is the founder's historical spreadsheet of batches that have already finished every step. An entry here started recently and has NOT finished every step yet: it draws its tracked ingredients from whatever real stock the live tenant currently holds (FIFO, oldest purchase_date first), not from a historical purchase ledger, since these ARE that stock. Maceration, distilling and aging (the VAT fill) are supported; each later step may carry its own date in step_dates, distilling records the two flask_codes, and aging records the vat_number chosen at the fill. Bottling/labelling are a deliberate follow-up. See scripts/whistlebird_recent_batches.py.
